SELECT st.id AS subjectId, st.pid, st.name, st.level, st.unit_name, st.path, st.bool_last_enum, ifnull(sc.code,'') code, ifnull(sc.number,1) number FROM subject st LEFT JOIN subject_config sc on sc.subject_id = st.id AND sc.UUID = #{uuid}
and subject.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND st.level = 1
ORDER BY st.pid desc
SELECT st.id AS subjectId, st.pid, st.name, st.level, st.unit_name, st.path, st.bool_last_enum FROM subject st where st.bool_delete_enum = 0 and st.path LIKE concat(#{path},'%')
